story: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a faster, cheaper everyday AI model, across Search, Sheets and the API
source_line: Sources: Google Keyword blog, Digital Trends, Notebookcheck

segments.label: THIS WEEK IN AI
segments.title: Google's everyday AI got 2.5x faster
segments.narration: Google's new everyday AI is two and a half times faster than its last.

segments.label: WHAT HAPPENED
segments.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen launches
segments.narration: Google launched Gemini four Hydrogen on November twelfth, replacing Gemini three point eight Flash as its everyday model.

segments.label: HOW IT WORKS
segments.title: Four thinking levels, one flat API price
segments.narration: It has four thinking levels. API input costs one dollar fifty per million tokens.

segments.label: WHAT IT MEANS FOR YOU
segments.title: Faster, but 'cheaper' is unproven
segments.narration: It may speed up Search and Sheets. The catch: Google hasn't said it's cheaper than Flash.

segments.label: OUR TAKE
segments.title: Test it on one real task first
segments.narration: Our take: test it on one real task before switching.
